svg.aria-label: Isometric illustration for AI product and developer tool design. On a dotted floor lies a low blue keyboard with white keys, a long space bar and one tall lime Enter key, pressed by a developer marked with code brackets. A dashed line runs straight back from the keyboard into the low base of a white card standing behind it: the first result, marked AI, with a line of code and three ticked checks the model ran. A reviewer marked with a tick stands at the card's corner with a hand on its sign-off button.
